title: Verify GenerateQuestionSavingErrorMessage handles TrackerResult without details
description: Ensures the error message generator returns default error message when TrackerResult has no details available.

manual_steps.action: Trigger a checklist save operation that results in a TrackerResult with HasDetails = false
manual_steps.expected_result: Default AJAX error message is returned from GenerateQuestionSavingErrorMessage method
manual_steps.notes: This tests the fallback error handling when no specific error details are available

manual_steps.action: Verify the returned message matches the localized default error text

title: Verify permission error message generation for checklist questions
description: Ensures proper error message is generated when user lacks permission to save checklist questions.
preconditions: User does not have CanSaveProposal permission

manual_steps.action: Attempt to save checklist questions without proper permissions
manual_steps.expected_result: Permission error is captured in TrackerResult with PermissionError status

manual_steps.action: Check the generated error message from GenerateQuestionSavingErrorMessage
manual_steps.notes: Verifies correct localized permission error message is returned

review_note: Button selector and error message display location need UI verification

title: Verify step completion conflict error when another user closes the step
description: Ensures proper error handling when workflow step is completed by another user during current user's edit session.
preconditions: User A and User B both have checklist access
Same workflow step is open in both user sessions
User B completes the step first

manual_steps.action: User A attempts to save checklist questions after User B has already completed the step
manual_steps.notes: This simulates concurrent user conflict scenario

manual_steps.action: Verify the error message generated includes the step closure notification
manual_steps.notes: Users should be informed about the conflict clearly

review_note: Concurrent user testing requires specific test environment setup and UI element confirmation

title: Verify checklist question closure validation with missing action text
description: Ensures questions requiring actions cannot be closed without providing action text.
preconditions: Checklist question requires an action to close
Question is being marked as closed

manual_steps.action: Mark a checklist question as closed without providing required action text
manual_steps.notes: System should enforce action text requirement

manual_steps.action: Verify error message includes the specific question ID that failed
manual_steps.expected_result: Error message contains question ID and text from Localization.Orders.ServiceStatus_ChecklistQuestionsCannotCloseWithMissingActionText
manual_steps.notes: Error should be specific to the failing question

review_note: Checkbox selector and validation error display need UI verification

title: Verify GetDisplayIdsToRefresh excludes warning items correctly
description: Ensures that when saving checklist questions results in warnings, those warning items are excluded from refresh list while successful items are included.

manual_steps.action: Submit checklist questions where some succeed and some generate warnings
manual_steps.expected_result: TrackerResult contains mix of success and warning statuses for different questions

manual_steps.action: Check the returned display IDs from GetDisplayIdsToRefresh method
manual_steps.expected_result: Only successful question IDs are returned, warning question IDs are excluded from refresh list
manual_steps.notes: Warning items should not be refreshed to preserve user input

title: Verify CreateStepClassSelectListItems filters closed steps correctly
description: Ensures step selection list includes only open steps when current step is not closed, but includes all steps of the class when current step is closed.
preconditions: Workflow has multiple steps of same class
Some steps are complete, some are incomplete
User needs to move item to different step

manual_steps.action: Access step selection dropdown when current step is open
manual_steps.expected_result: Only incomplete steps of the same class appear in the dropdown list
manual_steps.notes: Closed steps should be filtered out for open current steps

manual_steps.action: Access step selection dropdown when current step is closed
manual_steps.expected_result: All steps of the same class appear in dropdown, including completed ones
manual_steps.notes: When current step is closed, all steps should be available for selection

review_note: Dropdown selector and option counting need UI verification
